versions.changelog:
Initial release of Staghorn Fern Expert skill.

  - 18 Platycerium species identification with care profiles
  - Science-based care advice covering watering, light, mounting, fertilizer, propagation, and more
  - Symptom-based problem diagnosis (brown tips, root rot, pests, dormancy)
  - 400+ hybrid cultivar database across 11 lineage categories
  - Multilingual support: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
  - Offline-first: all knowledge built-in, no API calls needed
